question: A 16-year-old boy presents to the emergency room with severe right shoulder pain following a painful overhead swing during a competitive volleyball match. On physical examination, the patient has limited active range of motion of the right shoulder and significant pain with passive motion. Suspecting a rotator cuff injury, the physician obtains an MRI, which indicates a minor tear in the tendon of the rotator cuff muscle that is innervated by the axillary nerve. Which of the following muscles was affected?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Patient presents with right shoulder pain" -> "MRI shows minor tear in rotator cuff" -> "Rotator cuff muscles include infraspinatus, supraspinatus, subscapularis, teres major, teres minor" -> "Tendon innervated by axillary nerve" -> "Axillary nerve innervates teres minor and deltoid" -> "Tear likely affects teres minor" -> 85%

CHAIN: "16-year-old boy with shoulder pain after volleyball" -> "Physical exam shows limited active range of motion" -> "MRI indicates minor rotator cuff tear" -> "Rotator cuff muscles are infraspinatus, supraspinatus, subscapularis, teres major, teres minor" -> "Axillary nerve innervates teres minor" -> "Minor tear likely involves teres minor" -> 90%

CHAIN: "Severe right shoulder pain after overhead swing" -> "MRI reveals minor rotator cuff tear" -> "Rotator cuff includes infraspinatus, supraspinatus, subscapularis, teres major, teres minor" -> "Injury involves tendon innervated by axillary nerve" -> "Axillary nerve primarily affects teres minor" -> "Tear likely involves teres minor" -> 80%
analysis: The axillary nerve innervates the deltoid and teres minor muscles. Since the question specifies a rotator cuff muscle affected by a minor tear, and the only rotator cuff muscle innervated by the axillary nerve is the teres minor, this is the correct answer.
